description: List the members of a tar (plain or compressed), zip or 7z archive without extracting any: path, type, size, time, mode, link target and where each member sits in the archive.
covers: The archive's own list of members. It opens no member, searches no contents and lists no archive inside the archive: a member is extracted separately (the base pack ships no member extractor yet; an archive_extract tool is planned) and catalogued on its own.
